events: MES.Execution.WOCompleted.v1 when all required operations are Finished

requires: reason text when catalog requires comment

transitions.note: Abort is an interrupted attempt, not production failure.

invariants: Only non-print manual operations accept Start, Complete, Fail, Abort, or Retry.
Confirm requires the matching authoritative IN_PROGRESS session and cannot accept Pending.
Successors are executable only after every predecessor is Finished.
A failed operation and its transitive successors prevent Work Order completion.
Scrap greater than zero requires an approved scrap reason but still completes successfully when quantity rules pass.
Every mutation and outbox event is committed in one transaction.
Every command is idempotent and history is append-only.

retry_policy.OPERATOR: May retry an ExecutionError created by the same operator at the same terminal and site.
retry_policy.PLANT_MANAGER: May retry any manual ExecutionError within the authorized site.

progress: manual_progress_percent = completed_manual_job_cards / total_manual_job_cards * 100; it is not Work Order completion and excludes Print Station operations.
